guitar.guitaristsText: Jonny Greenwood / Ed O'Brien / Thom Yorke
guitar.evidence: Jonny Greenwood's Telecaster Plus and Ed O'Brien's Stratocasters/Jazzmasters are well documented among Radiohead gear-heads.

tone.target: jangly clean acoustic-like electric with light chorus
tone.profile: jangly clean acoustic-like electric with light chorus
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain emphasizing clarity (Comp), brightness (Green OD/Boost), classic clean tone (US Deluxe), and shimmering arpeggios (Chorus).
corrections: keep it more dry and acoustic-like

rig.name: Radiohead - High And Dry - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide subtle compression and even out the attack for a tight sound.
Add subtle grit and brightness to mimic a clean Fender/Vox boost.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here as a mild, bright boost rather than an overdrive for maximum clarity.

alternatives.reason: A general clean boost could also work.

blocks.purpose: Bypass (No wah needed for this clean arpeggio tone).
Bypass (Keep the tone clean and bright).
Simulate the clean, bright character of a Fender/Vox amp.
Provide a bright and articulate cabinet sound suitable for clean arpeggios.
Slightly boost the high end to enhance the 'jangly' arpeggio quality.
blocks.gap: A dedicated EQ is needed to fine-tune the bright, acoustic-like character.

blocks.purpose: Add the required very light chorus effect for shimmer and width.
Add subtle space and dimension without sounding like a 'wash' or big reverb.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is chosen over Plate/Spring to provide natural, controlled ambience.

alternatives.reason: Could also work for subtle space.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall clarity to achieve a more authentic acoustic-like electric tone.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, articulate sound needed for arpeggios and clean tones.
